A single dialogue portrait for a top-down pixel-art RPG: a HEAD-AND-SHOULDERS BUST of one character, drawn face-on toward the viewer, chest up. The head must be large in the frame — the face fills most of it — with the shoulders cut off at the bottom edge of the picture; NEVER a full-body figure, NEVER a waist-up or three-quarter-length figure, and never more than one character. Leave a comfortable margin of empty background on all four sides so nothing is cropped: no part of the hair, ears, horns, hat or shoulders may touch or run off any edge. The background is FLAT PURE WHITE (#FFFFFF), completely uniform, with a crisp hard edge against the character and no blended halo, no vignette, no gradient, no drop shadow — the white is keyed out mechanically afterwards and anything else in it becomes a grey fringe around the character. Style: the same clean, flat, cel-shaded cartoon look as the game's character sprites, readable at small size — bold shapes, few colours, no photorealism, no painterly texture, no heavy rendering. The character: {CHARACTER}. Draw the face with a clear, legible expression, looking at the viewer. Only draw the parts of them that are actually above the chest — the hair, the face, the eyes, the headwear, the collar of the garment. Anything worn on the WRISTS, HANDS, WAIST, LEGS or FEET is simply out of frame in a bust: do NOT relocate a bracelet to the neck as a necklace or choker, do not add jewellery that was not described, and do not draw hands or arms. Use any reference image ONLY for design and colour likeness, never for pose or crop. Nothing else in the image: no text, no labels, no borders, no frame, no props, no scenery, no second figure.
